changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'fusion' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Result_backup') BEGIN drop table fusion.Result_backup; END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'fusion' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Result_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [fusion].[Result_backup]( [ExecutionID] [int] NOT NULL, [FusionAttributeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Body] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [ID] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [FieldTypeID] [int] NULL, [FieldName] [nvarchar](250) CONSTRAINT [DF_FusionResult_FieldName] DEFAULT ('Name') NOT NULL, [Action] [varchar](1) NULL, [OldValue] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [NewValue] [nvarchar](max) NULL ) END
